// diagnostic

E1260

A sandbox's exported function has an unsupported signature.

What

A sandbox's exported function has an unsupported signature.

Why

Every parameter and the return type of a sandbox export must use the same Component Model scalar: `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, or `Text`.

Fix

Narrow the signature to one homogeneous scalar shape, or drop `pub` if this function isn't meant to be called across the sandbox boundary.
